notes.title: Patch 1.4.4
notes.content:
🗺️ [b]New Features[/b]

🏝️ Island: Snowpeaks (unlocks at level 20, accessible via the boat north of Megis Island)
🏛️ Building: Theater
👤 NPC: Cedric, with a new quest chain
🔮 Relic System: Unlocked by completing Cedric's quest chain. Grants passive bonuses like +40% movement speed, resource production boosts, and more
🧲 Item Magnet: Automatically attracts pickable items to the player
✨ New Content: Items, ores, and minable rocks in dungeons

⚙️ [b]Improvements[/b]

⚡ Performance: Major performance boosts and shorter loading times
🎥 Camera: Smoother camera movement
🎨 UI: Updated UI design and new font
⚖️ Game Balance:
Increased chance to gain profession skill points
Monster balance adjustments in dungeons

🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]

🖥️ Smoothness: Fixed smooth screen movement on PC
🔊 Sound: Fixed sound issues when entering/exiting houses
🎶 Ambiance: Fixed ambiance and music switching
🌍 Localization: Improved localization and text size in various languages
😊 Emotes: Increased emote interaction UI size
🔧 General: Various other general fixes and improvements
